entities.title: UTV-first examples
entities.summary: Examples organized by UTV class and function: each test does a task with UTV and compares the result with Date, Intl.DateTimeFormat or JSON.
entities.purpose: One file per UTV class or JSON-layer function (civil-date.test.ts, zoned-intent.test.ts, validate-structural.test.ts, …), with a describe per class and per function. Where UTV and the standard API agree, the expected value is computed with the standard API; where they differ, it is a literal and the doc comment says what the standard API does. Tests wrapped in // BEGIN <task-id> … // END <task-id> are laid out on docs/side-by-side.md.
boundaries: The catalog of scenarios is docs/example-tests.md, owned by docs/.
The expected values computed with Intl.DateTimeFormat need a host tz database that knows the 2026–2027 rules of New York and Paris.
